known_issues: Source bytes and independent expected identities must come from upstream authenticated immutable storage. This entrypoint neither authenticates their origin nor implements the sealing transaction.

Only the existing native-JSON canonical encoding is admitted. Alternate whitespace, escaping, numeric spelling, rounding and underflow representations are rejected, not rewritten. This is not general high-precision scientific JSON support.

A linear raw node/depth budget precheck runs before the standard decoder; strict JSON hooks and the existing native-object validator remain authoritative for validity. Finite admission bounds are not hard aggregate memory or time supervision.

The returned type and resource-profile SHA remain those of the unchanged structured-source inspection job. The separate source-admission profile pin does not add an execution signature or evidence that a particular entrypoint ran.
All existing guarded inspections and supported 64-page/8-MiB optional limits remain unchanged; graph-depth rejection remains effective. The standard rendering route remains 32 pages/8 MiB.

No retry, custom executor, arbitrary storage handle, checkpoint, profile upgrade or source refresh is accepted. No long-report delivery, full PDF/UA accessibility, scientific qualification or release is activated.
